channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kira Lewis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kira Lewis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Willie Green on Kira Lewis
item.description:
Will Guillory:Willie Green on Kira Lewis attending last night's game:

“It was really good to see Kira. Going through a tough injury at such a young age, it's just tough in anybody's career. He's a huge part of our group, our family. ... The guys went crazy. It was fun having him around.”

Willie Green on Kira Lewis, Mar 21, 2022. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on JJ Redick, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Kira Lewis
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Stan Van Gundy on Kira Lewis and Nickeil Alexander-Walker with JJ Redick sidelined:

“Just like with the rest of our team, we want to see them do a good job defensively. They need to bring us a lot of energy. (No) added pressure on them; they're just going to get opportunity.”

Stan Van Gundy on JJ Redick, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Kira Lewis, Mar 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Kira Lewis
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Stan Van Gundy on Kira Lewis Jr. competing on defense:

“He tried to stand in and take two charges last night (vs. Rockets). A 160-pound, 19-year-old kid, putting his body in front of NBA players going to the basket- I love it... I love his mindset and approach to the game.”

Stan Van Gundy on Kira Lewis, Feb 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.
